title: Zesty Winey Kenyan Pecan Nuts Flatbread
description: A winey, snappy, midnight-craving Kenyan dish featuring pecan nuts, double-rise-bread, and Mediterranean-friendly flavors, perfect for a satisfying snack.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine warm water and yeast, letting it sit for 5 minutes to activate the yeast.
Add flour, salt, sugar, and garlic powder to the bowl, mixing until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until it has doubled in size.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Punch down the dough and roll it out into a flat circle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Brush the dough with olive oil and sprinkle chopped pecan nuts over the top.
Drizzle red wine over the pecan nuts, making sure not to overload the flatbread.
Bake the flatbread in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until it is golden brown and crispy.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
